ruling.reason: C1 requires the remediation report to state a resolved or unresolved disposition for each of findings F-01 and F-02, and explicitly prohibits fulfillment by a statement that no review was performed. E1, authored by the auditor (0x775f9feb45a8564f5460db166c311885224d5730), affirmatively states: 'No remediation review was performed. Neither F-01 nor F-02 has been assessed. This document contains no resolved or unresolved disposition for either finding. The agreed review was not delivered.' This is a direct, positive admission that the required deliverable is absent — not merely silence or ambiguity. E2, submitted by the protocol owner, corroborates this by pointing to E1 as the basis for the dispute. The criterion is unambiguously NOT MET: E1 constitutes recorded evidence of a concrete, affirmatively stated failure to deliver the required finding-by-finding dispositions for both F-01 and F-02. The explicit carve-out in C1 ('A statement that no review was performed does not fulfill this obligation') precisely matches the content of E1. No other evidence establishes any disposition for either finding.
